content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Lawton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate degree, or international equivalent) and complete the required contact hours of project management education. No prior work experience is necessary—making CAPM accessible to career-changers and early-career professionals in Lawton's growing project-driven sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. This intensive format compresses the required education into a structured schedule, allowing Lawton professionals to balance certification training with work and personal commitments while learning directly from experienced instructors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and complete your official CAPM application, including proof of your secondary degree and completion of contact-hour requirements. Pay the associated examination fee to secure your testing eligibility and move forward in the credential process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review core project-management concepts, practice questions, and test-taking strategies. Schedule your CAPM exam through PMI's authorized testing partner and sit for the assessment on your chosen date and location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your CAPM, commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) during the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer multiple pathways—courses, volunteer work, and continuing education—to keep your credential current and your skills sharp.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
